text:
Maya: Heads-up 12: webinar landing needs final SEO + redirects before we push marketing emails. Can someone confirm canonical, keyword targets, and the redirect map?

Noah: I can handle the canonical + meta. Recommend canonical: /webinars/inference-playbook — short and keyword-friendly. Meta title draft: "Inference Economics & Latency: Redwood webinar". Meta desc: "Join our webinar for benchmarks on latency vs cost and practical tips for serving LLMs. Register now."

Priya: KW sets (short list): primary: ["inference economics", "LLM serving benchmarks", "reduce inference cost"]; secondary: ["private inference", "quantization for production"]. Also want "webinar recording" variations in meta for long-tail.

Ben: Redirects I'll roll into a Netlify PR. Avoid redirect chains and preserve query params for UTM. Draft rules:
```
/old-inference-webinar  /webinars/inference-playbook  301  
/webinars/inference-economics-2025  /webinars/inference-playbook  301
/launchs/inference-guide  /docs/inference/getting-started  301
```
Make sure we canonicalize any tag pages that also list the webinar.

Maya: Also need structured data. Prefer Event + VideoObject (for recording) + FAQ. Minimal JSON-LD example for the video: 
```json
{
  "@context":"https://schema.org",
  "@type":"VideoObject",
  "name":"Inference Economics webinar recording",
  "uploadDate":"2026-04-13T10:00:00Z",
  "contentUrl":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook/recording"
}
```

Priya: Internal linking plan: add contextual links from these high-traffic pages: /docs/inference/getting-started, /blog/serving-costs, /benchmarks/latency-cost. Add a banner CTA on the docs and a mention in the benchmarks narrative (we'll link anchor text "inference economics webinar").

Noah: Inbound routing: set UTM_campaign=webinar_inference_playbook_apr and tag form submissions with source=webinar_playbook. For HubSpot: create workflow that tags leads as webinar_playbook, sets lead score +15 for attendance, and moves attendees into the SDR queue for follow-up.

Ben: QA checklist before go-live: check 1) rel=canonical present, 2) JSON-LD validates in Rich Results, 3) no 404s on old URLs, 4) redirects are single-hop. I'll run the preview and share the Netlify link.

SEO Bot: Crawl scheduled at 2009991800. Will report redirect chains, missing canonical tags, and any schema errors.

Maya: Great. Priya/Noah/Bob (that's Ben) please update the launch board with owners and link the PR. We'll hold emails until redirects + schema pass QA. Thanks all :rocket:
